stdout is log text: the converted runner logs under the [enrich_ravines] tag with its own target/gate/phase lines (scripts/lib/step/index.js:296, :4783) where the legacy script logged its own lines, so line-by-line text differs (sources 2→4 lines; standalone 2→4 lines).
